name: DVF — Demandes de valeurs foncières
positioning: Every French property transaction of the last five years, published as open data by the tax administration — free, and the base layer under most French valuation products.
description: DVF publishes the property transactions registered by the French tax administration: address, date, price, surface, property type and land parcel, covering most of the country and updated twice a year. It is available as bulk open data, through a public API and through a free map application.
real_estate_use: It is the closest thing France has to public sale comparables. An agent checks what the flat two floors down actually sold for, an investor tests a seller's price claim, an appraiser builds a comparables table with a verifiable public source. Its limits matter as much: Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte are excluded, sales are registered several months late, and the price is the recorded transfer price, not the negotiated market story behind it.
features: Registered transaction price, date, surface and property type
Coverage of most of France over a rolling five-year window
Free bulk open data download and public API
Free map application for address-level consultation
Land parcel references linking to cadastral data

use_cases.job: Check what comparable properties in the building actually sold for
Build a comparables table on a source the client can verify independently
